data.narrative:
Reveal Technology is a Series A-stage defense and security company founded by Garrett Smith that has raised $30M+ to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-sector, same-stage private companies (Stark Defence, Singularity, and NODA AI), supplemented by a broader universe of 10 total comparables including 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers such as Anduril Industries and Helsing.

The Stage-Progression method was not applicable due to an unreliable funding-tracker base value that implied a $2.0B valuation—more than 20x the company's total raised capital. The Peer-Median method proves tractable: the 3 same-stage, same-sector peers exhibit a median valuation of $400M, with a range spanning $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence). This wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and market positioning within the frontier defense tech space.

The triangulated valuation range stands at $340M–$460M, centered on a $400M median. This narrow synthesis reflects reliance on a single applicable method. Key uncertainties include the outsized influence of the Stark Defence $4.0B outlier on peer dispersion, differentiation in technology defensibility and customer concentration relative to named comparables, and the generalizability of public-market multiples to this private, capital-intensive sector.
